scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 6 boards of two live Deity Russia Religious-target games (civvis-20261110T012017Z at t120, t150, t160, t170, t180 with 1,563 to 3,343 Faith banked, and civvis-20261110T001935Z at t148 with 1,288), each the run's events.jsonl cut at frame 0 of the turn. Both arms run one frozen civvis_orders --resumed built from the branch (f4ed77cac0) with the run's own requested genome; the on arm adds --with religion-seat-spends-the-bank. Orders differ on 5 of 6 boards: the on arm buys an Apostle with Faith where the off arm buys nothing on four of them and a Guru on one. The t120 board is unchanged.
